title: Affine Structure of the Brownian Signature
summary: We establish an infinite-dimensional affine transform theory for the time-augmented Brownian signature. Our first main result shows that, for a suitable class of linear functions of the signature, the conditional Fourier-Laplace transform admits an entire signature expansion. We prove that the associated coefficients solve an infinite-dimensional linear differential equation on the extended tensor algebra.
